name: Parallel Linear Assignment Sorting (PLAS)
definition: Sorts Gaussian splats into a 2D grid layout to improve cache coherence during rendering, based on the paper 'Compact 3D Scene Representation via Self-Organizing Gaussian Grids'.
summary: Parallel Linear Assignment Sorting is a highly parallel 2D algorithm that organizes millions of Gaussian splat attributes into a grid using block-wise linear assignment to avoid local minima.
